rv.q: This is an unforgettable experience that gives you plenty to unpack afterward, and it works well with friends or family, since you’ll move through it in small groups.
I revisited it last week and noticed some improvements to this intriguing show where a character named David guides you through multiple rooms and sensory experiments.
Theater of the Mind isn’t just theater, it’s truly a theatrical revelation best described as deeply imaginative human exploration.

cn.t: Critics largely praise David Byrne's immersive "Theater of the Mind" for its inventive concept and unique experience, with scores ranging from strong to near-perfect. A rewarding, if unconventional, night out.
